name: MIMIC-IV-ED: Emergency Department Relational Database
description: MIMIC-IV-ED is a public electronic health record dataset documenting emergency department (ED) visits to the Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center between 2008 and 2019, hosted on PhysioNet. Containing records for over 425,000 emergency department stays and 215,600 unique patients, the database captures the acute triage and stabilization phase before hospital admission or discharge. Tables document Emergency Severity Index (ESI) triage acuity scores, chief complaints, vital signs recorded upon arrival and throughout the stay, medication reconciliation, medications dispensed via automated pyxis dispensers, and diagnosis codes. All records seamlessly link to inpatient hospitalizations, ICU stays, and clinical notes in MIMIC-IV via shared patient identifiers.
